---
title: Publishing R package with asreml dependency
date: 2026-08-28
---

Since `asreml` is a propreity software, you cannot just import `asreml` in an R package that depends on it. 

In the DESCRIPTION file, you ought to add that 

```bash
SystemRequirements:
    asreml (>= 4.2.0)
```

Some R packages on CRAN that has an asreml R dependency:


::: {.cell}

:::


- [agriutilities](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/agriutilities/index.html)
- [asremlPlus](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/asremlPlus/index.html)
- [ASRgenomics](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ASRgenomics/index.html)
- [biometryassist](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/biometryassist/index.html)
- [heritable](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/heritable/index.html)
- [mintyr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mintyr/index.html)
- [nadiv](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/nadiv/index.html)
- [statgenGxE](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/statgenGxE/index.html)
- [statgenHTP](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/statgenHTP/index.html)
- [statgenSTA](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/statgenSTA/index.html)
- [wgaim](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/wgaim/index.html)
